speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

Thank you for that information; the presence of grunting and retractions in a 33-week preterm infant is highly suggestive of Respiratory Distress Syndrome caused by surfactant deficiency. I have requested an Arterial Blood Gas and a Chest X-Ray to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes like sepsis or pneumonia.
